@next/eslint-plugin-next.applicability: Build/development file globs and generated component tooling. The deployed app does not accept user-supplied glob patterns or expose these CLIs. Trusted repository files can still trigger resource exhaustion in developer/CI tooling.
@next/eslint-plugin-next.remediation: Keep lint/component tooling on compatible releases; monitor upstream braces patch and parent upgrades. Do not apply the suggested old Next.js/shadcn major downgrade. Review before the next release or 2026-11-09.

@prisma/config.applicability: Prisma CLI configuration merging uses trusted local configuration. No user-submitted recursive object graph is passed to deepmerge-ts. Production database queries use Prisma Client and the PostgreSQL adapter, not CLI configuration merging.
@prisma/config.remediation: Track aligned Prisma 7 and its config dependency update to deepmerge-ts 8. Avoid overriding a major API without upstream compatibility evidence. Review before the next release or 2026-11-09.
